# ProcedureLog schemas
{: .no_toc}

Entry schemas for procedure logs: measurements followed over time for one procedure.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`procedurelog`](/api/modules/procedurelog/): `type` selects the type; each log entry added through the entry actions is validated against it.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ProcedureLog/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ProcedureLog/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ProcedureLog/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Impedances log

- type code `Impedances` · version 1.0.3 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ProcedureLog/Impedances/1.0.3.json)

Logs electrode impedance measurements per channel, with impedance and phase values, unit and measurement frequency, for example to track an implant over days.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `impedances` | Impedances | multi-select | yes |  | Impedance values ordered to correspond to the listed channels. |
| `impedanceUnit` | Impedance unit | choice |  | one of `Ω`, `kΩ`, `MΩ`; default `"kΩ"` | The unit shared by all impedance values in this log entry. |
| `measurementFrequency` | Measurement frequency | quantity with unit |  | units `Hz`, `kHz`; default `{"unit": "kHz"}` | The stimulus frequency used for the impedance measurement. |
| `phases` | Phases (°) | multi-select |  |  | Phase angles ordered to correspond to the listed channels. |
| `channels` | List of channels | list of integers |  |  | Channel numbers corresponding by position to the impedance and phase arrays. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "impedances": [
        "text"
    ],
    "impedanceUnit": "Ω",
    "measurementFrequency": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "kHz"
    }
}
```


## Linear displacement log

- type code `LinearDisplacement` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ProcedureLog/LinearDisplacement/1.1.1.json)

Logs the displacement of a movable implant at each log time, for example a probe advanced on a microdrive.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `displacement` | Displacement | quantity with unit | yes | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `cm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | The signed or absolute displacement recorded at this log time. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "displacement": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "µm"
    }
}
```


## Tetrode adjustment log

- type code `TetrodeAdjustment` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ProcedureLog/TetrodeAdjustment/1.0.0.json)

Logs adjustments of individual tetrodes on a drive, with one row per tetrode moved at each log time.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `tetrodes` | Tetrode adjustments | table of rows | yes | format table | One row per tetrode adjusted at this log time; tetrodes left untouched are omitted. |
| `tetrodes[].tetrode` | Tetrode | integer | yes | ≥ 1 | Position of the tetrode on the drive, numbered from 1 as the lab labels it. |
| `tetrodes[].advance` | Advance | quantity with unit | yes | units `µm`, `mm`, `turn`, `°`; default `{"unit": "turn"}` | How far the tetrode was moved in this adjustment, as a distance or as screw rotation; negative values retract. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "tetrodes": [
        {
            "tetrode": 1,
            "advance": {
                "value": 1,
                "unit": "turn"
            }
        }
    ]
}
```
